faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Calicut JRF/PA I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 02-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.E./M.Tech in Chemical Engineering/Biotechnology with NET/GATE or a Bachelor's degree in the same fields with first-class marks and a valid NET/GATE score.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate I positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for these positions is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF and PA I roles?
faq.answer: For JRF, the salary is Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA (for NET/GATE qualified candidates). For PA I, it is Rs. 30,000 + 20% HRA (for non-NET/GATE candidates).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Calicut recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate I posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any desirable qualifications for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, experience in enzyme production and characterisation, and process modelling and simulation is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The link to download the official notification PDF is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
